title: Battle of Anegawa
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Anegawa", at revision 1370106797, opens: "The Sengoku period Battle of Anegawa  occurred near Lake Biwa in Ōmi Province, Japan, between the allied forces of Oda Nobunaga and Tokugawa Ieyasu, against the combined forces of the Azai and Asakura clans. It is notable as the first battle that involved the alliance between Nobunaga and Ieyasu, and it saw Nobunaga's prodigious use of firearms." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q964983, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1570 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
